title: 〜抜く
meaning: to do … through to the end; to do … thoroughly
simpleExplanation: Verb stem + 抜く means to carry an action through to the very end despite difficulty, or to do it thoroughly: 走り抜く (run all the way), 考え抜く (think through completely), 耐え抜く (endure to the end). The nuance is perseverance and completeness.
whenUsed: Both speech and writing; common in motivational contexts, sports, and narratives. Compared with 〜切る, which simply marks completion, 〜抜く stresses the struggle and determination.
formation: Common verbs: 走り抜く・考え抜く・耐え抜く・生き抜く・やり抜く・戦い抜く・守り抜く
Past: 〜抜いた / Continuative: 〜抜いて / Noun: 〜抜き (rare)

rows.label: Core idea
cells: carry through to the end despite hardship
keep doing consistently to the end

examples.ja: 苦しかったが、最後まで走り抜いた。
examples.reading: くるしかったが、さいごまではしりぬいた。
examples.en: It was painful, but I ran through to the end.
examples.note: Running to the finish despite pain: perseverance.

examples.ja: 考え抜いた末に、会社を辞めることにした。
examples.reading: かんがえぬいたすえに、かいしゃをやめることにした。
examples.en: After thinking it through thoroughly, I decided to quit the company.
examples.note: 考え抜いた末に: after thinking it through completely.

examples.ja: 困難な状況を耐え抜いた。
examples.reading: こんなんなじょうきょうをたえぬいた。
examples.en: I endured the difficult situation to the end.
examples.note: Enduring a hard situation to the end.

examples.ja: どんなに大変でも、この仕事を最後までやり抜くつもりだ。
examples.reading: どんなにたいへんでも、このしごとをさいごまでやりぬくつもりだ。
examples.en: No matter how hard it is, I intend to see this job through to the end.
examples.note: やり抜く: one of the most common 抜く compounds.

examples.ja: 戦争の時代を生き抜いた祖父の話を聞いた。
examples.reading: せんそうのじだいをいきぬいたそふのはなしをきいた。
examples.en: I listened to my grandfather, who survived the war years.
examples.note: 生き抜く: survive through hardship.

similarGrammar.difference: Completion or exhaustion (食べ切る, 使い切る); no nuance of struggle.
Persist consistently (やり通す, 押し通す); close to 抜く but without the sense of hardship overcome.
Different pattern: Noun + 抜き = without.

commonMistakes.why: 抜く needs hardship or thoroughness; simple completion of a meal is 切る.
Attach 抜く to the ます-stem, not the dictionary form.

commonMistakes.right: 考え抜いて決めた。/ 考え抜いた末に決めた。
commonMistakes.why: Use the て-form or 〜た末に to connect to the decision.

usageNotes: Often paired with 最後まで / 徹底的に / どんなに〜ても.
考え抜いた末に is a set phrase for a carefully considered decision.
Some compounds have their own meanings: 見抜く (see through a lie), 追い抜く (overtake).
jlptTips: If the sentence stresses hardship overcome (苦しかったが / どんなに大変でも), 抜く beats 切る.
Check the stem: 走り抜く, not 走る抜く.
Distractors include 切る, 通す, 終わる; also watch for 見抜く / 追い抜く, which have separate meanings.
